description: Committee recommends $1.2M for winter warming centres.
Remaining $1M from other governments, groups, donors.
Project budget could increase with external funding.

chips.text: Recommended
Councillor DePaul questioned the lack of a detailed budget breakdown for the $1.2M funding.
Salvation Army delegate highlighted increased need for warming centres this winter.
Plan includes separate warming locations for men and women experiencing homelessness.
Administration committed to providing a more detailed budget breakdown to Council.

description: City to review Central Ave, Reid Road, Rossmo Road intersection safety.
Report on traffic lights, past studies, and future plans.

chips.text: Councillor McDonald successfully amended the motion to include past and future traffic studies.
Residents near Central Ave, Reid Road, and Rossmo Road concerned about safety.
52 residents met with former Councillor Hill to discuss intersection safety concerns.

description: Administration to report on fleet services review.

chips.text: Motion amended to request report on ongoing review, not direct audit.
City employees affected by fleet services review.

description: Administration to report on green space weed management, including herbicide use.

chips.text: Approved
11 for, 0 against
Councillor Jeffries noted Saskatoon has not used herbicides since 1994, and "it shows."
Safety of sports fields is impacted by current weed management.
Councillor Parker raised environmental concerns about noxious and invasive weeds.
Administration confirmed the report will include noxious and invasive weed management.

description: City administration will report on residential security camera privacy issues.

chips.text: Approved
11 for, 0 against
Councillor Jeffries noted the issue of residential cameras will likely grow with technology.
Residents using or affected by external residential security cameras.
The report will address a 'gray zone' regarding privacy and enforcement of camera use.
